# Fix issue #6849 — Work public-monitor falsely `unavailable`; issue health floods UNKNOWN; fleet_reviews AttributeError

You are an implementation agent in a dispatch worktree. Read GitHub issue #6849 in full,
INCLUDING the triage comment (root-cause diagnosis is recorded there), before writing code.

## Evidence discipline (#M-4)
Every claim in your PR description and final report must be tool-backed: name the
deterministic command and quote its raw output. No asserted-but-unprobed "works now".

## Scope (all three symptoms of #6849 — see the issue's Expected section)
1. On a healthy Monitor, the `fleet_reviews` section of `GET /api/work/v1/projection`
   must be `ok` — no `fleet_reviews_error:AttributeError`. Fix the cause at the right
   layer, not by swallowing the exception.
2. When the core GitHub enumerations (issues, prs) succeed, the `public-monitor` source
   status must NOT read `unavailable` because optional/class-4 sections (streams,
   fleet_reviews) failed. Use a degraded-class status while keeping every omission
   visible in the per-section metadata. Do not hide failures; re-classify them honestly.
3. A missing streams cache (fresh Monitor start) must not leave the board useless:
   real PR health signals must not be buried under a 100-row UNKNOWN pile. The
   reporter accepts either restoring streams availability at Monitor start or keeping
   issue health honest without pretending the source is down — choose the root-cause
   layer and justify the choice in the PR description.

Non-goals: no changes to the private adapter, no redaction-contract changes, no
attention-default UX change (that is #6850, running in a parallel task — do not touch
`dashboards/work.html`).

# Pull Request Opened: [#6853](https://github.com/learn-ukrainian/learn-ukrainian.github.io/pull/6853)

**Branch**: `agy/work-6849-projection-health`  
**Commit**: [`57e538a7d6`](https://github.com/learn-ukrainian/learn-ukrainian.github.io/commit/57e538a7d6) (`fix(work): correct fleet_reviews route defaults and public-monitor status degradation (#6849)`)  
**Target Issue**: Fixes #6849

---

## Root Cause Analysis & Changes

### 1. `fleet_reviews` AttributeError
- **Root Cause**: [`scripts/api/fleet_router.py`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/work-6849-projection-health/scripts/api/fleet_router.py#L2027-L2040) used parameter defaults like `kind: str | None = Query(default=None)`. When [`fetch_fleet_reviews`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/work-6849-projection-health/scripts/work/sources_public.py#L544-L566) called [`fleet_reviews`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/work-6849-projection-health/scripts/api/fleet_router.py#L2027) directly as a Python function, unpassed parameters received `fastapi.params.Query` sentinel objects instead of `None`, causing [`_normalize_time`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/work-6849-projection-health/scripts/api/fleet_router.py#L152-L162) to raise `AttributeError: 'Query' object has no attribute 'replace'`.
- **Fix**: Migrated parameter definitions in [`fleet_reviews`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/work-6849-projection-health/scripts/api/fleet_router.py#L2027-L2042) to standard FastAPI `Annotated[T, Query(...)] = default` annotations, ensuring clean Python function invocations use real defaults (`None`, `DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE`, `0`).

### 2. Public Monitor Source Status Degradation
- **Root Cause**: [`public_source_envelope`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/work-6849-projection-health/scripts/work/sources_public.py#L692-L737) previously reduced overall source status to the worst status across all sections. Failures in optional/class-4 sections (`streams`, `fleet_reviews`, etc.) painted the entire public source `unavailable` even when core GitHub enumerations (`issues`, `prs`) succeeded.
- **Fix**: Updated [`public_source_envelope`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/work-6849-projection-health/scripts/work/sources_public.py#L716-L737) to reclassify non-success in optional/class-4 sections as `degraded` (or `stale`/`truncated`) when core enumerations (`issues`, `prs`) succeed, keeping per-section errors visible in `sections` metadata and `denominator.omissions`. True failures in core enumerations (`issues` or `prs`) still mark the source `unavailable`/`timeout`.

### 3. Streams Cache Availability & Honest Issue Health
- **Root Cause & Justification**: When streams cache is missing (e.g., fresh Monitor restart), [`fetch_streams_projection`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/work-6849-projection-health/scripts/work/sources_public.py#L351-L377) previously did not trigger background cache generation, and [`derive_health`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/work-6849-projection-health/scripts/work/attention.py#L48-L102) produced `UNKNOWN` (`authority_unknown`) for all issues.
- **Fix**:
  1. [`fetch_streams_projection`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/work-6849-projection-health/scripts/work/sources_public.py#L356-L373) now triggers [`schedule_refresh(force=False)`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/work-6849-projection-health/scripts/orchestration/issue_stream_audit.py#L443) when `report is None`.
  2. [`scripts/api/main.py::_lifespan`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/work-6849-projection-health/scripts/api/main.py#L109-L130) schedules background stream cache warming upon Monitor startup.
  3. While streams cache is missing, issue health honestly remains `UNKNOWN` without misrepresenting the source as down, and attention sorting ensures real PR signals (e.g. failing CI `OFF_TRACK` / pending review `AT_RISK`) rank at the top ahead of the `UNKNOWN` issue tier.

### 3. Mutation Checks (#M-16)
- **Mutation 1 (`fleet_reviews` defaults)**: Reverting parameters from `Annotated[..., Query()] = None` back to `Query(default=None)` reproduces `AttributeError: 'Query' object has no attribute 'replace'` in `_normalize_time`, failing [`test_fleet_reviews_direct_python_call_with_defaults`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/work-6849-projection-health/tests/test_fleet_observer_api.py#L582) and [`test_fetch_fleet_reviews_production_default_loader`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/work-6849-projection-health/tests/test_work_contract.py#L2010).
- **Mutation 2 (`public_source_envelope` status reduction)**: Reverting to unconstrained worst-status reduction sets public source status to `unavailable` when `fleet_reviews` or `streams` is unavailable even though `issues` and `prs` are `ok`, failing [`test_public_source_envelope_independent_degradation_matrix`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/work-6849-projection-health/tests/test_work_contract.py#L2022).
